about: The evangelium of the formulary “Sunday after Ascension” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time Jesus said to His disciples: When the Paraclete cometh, Whom I will send you from the Father, the Spirit of truth Who proceedeth from the Father, He shall give testimony of Me; and you shall give testimony, because you are with Me from the beginning. These things have I spoken to you that you may not be scandalized. They will put you out of the synagogues; yea, the hour cometh that whosoever killeth you will think that he doth a service to God. And these things will they do to you because they have not known the Father nor Me. But these things I have told you, that when the hour shall come you may remember that I told you of them.
